decision_scope: SELECT_ONLY_THE_POSITION_1_OPI_AUTHORING_STRATEGY; DO_NOT_AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_OPI, CREATE_CANONICAL_SLOT_IDS_OR_LABELS, UNLOCK_QA, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

strategy_decisions.statement: Preserve VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE as the complete closed source package for position 1 during strategy selection.
Do not choose one realization over the other in this strategy gate.
Do not assert subject/person, tense/aspect, copula or natural-language translation semantics.
Do not author or validate an OPI artifact in this strategy gate.
If approved, open only a separate position-1 OPI artifact-design gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Strategy approval is not OPI authoring or OPI validation.
Internal selector 1 remains NONCANONICAL_STRUCTURAL_INDEX_ONLY and no canonical OPI ID or label is created.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN and PARAZAMI WATCH lexical authorities remain unchanged.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this position-1 OPI authoring strategy while this gate remains active.
